feature.howTitle: How the Best Burger Contest works
feature.howSub: Run by the Green County Beef Producers. Every contest burger you eat earns a stamp on your voting card.
steps: Order the contest burger and ask your server for a voting card.
Get your card stamped before you leave. One burger is one stamp, so if you share a burger, you share the vote.
Try at least half of the contest burgers (12 of 24 in 2026) for your vote to count.
Each burger you try adds a point to your favorite. Try all of them and your #1 gets the most points.
Send your card to the Green County Beef Producers by August 6.
12 or more stamps puts you in the gift card drawing. Try every burger to enter the beef bundle grand prize drawing.
feature.note: Voting runs April 1 to July 31 each year. The 2027 contest starts April 1, 2027.

faq.a: 132 N Riverview St in downtown Bellevue, Iowa.
